name: Battle Minigames
desc:
Battle Minigames is a fast-paced and round based fighting game where you or your team must battle other players to win! 🏹🔥

Earn coins by beating other players and winning the games 🏆
Use your coins to buy new weapons and gear to use in game 🎈💣🔪

Like if you enjoyed! 👍
